nusmp.page.book_dark.dark_cloak: Dark Cloaked Guard - darkness wraps you for fifteen seconds: resistance, absorption, and twelve percent of the damage you deal comes back to you as healing.
nusmp.page.book_dark.shadow_embrace: Dark Cloaked Shadow Embrace - a void opens round you for four seconds: foes are slowed, blinded and drained of magicules, up to five at a time.
nusmp.page.book_dark.black_hole_collapse: Black Hole Collapse - a great black hole at the aim point pulls foes in for three and a half seconds (never a boss), swallows spells, then collapses for 30 damage.
